ValidationRule.description: Unapproved projects whose sqrt(risk)*e^-completion*ln(risk+1) exceeds log10(budget) are too risky for their size.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNULL(Risk_Score__c)), Risk_Score__c > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Budget__c)), NOT(Is_Approved__c), ROUND(SQRT(Risk_Score__c) * EXP(-NULLVALUE(Completion_Pct__c, 0)) * LN(Risk_Score__c + 1), 3) > LOG(MAX(10, Budget__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Risk score is too high for the budget and completion level of this unapproved project.
